areas.name: Design Tokens
areas.description: The foundational values for color, type, spacing, and breakpoints that every component is built from.

areas.name: Components
areas.description: The React component library organized by complexity, from basic building blocks up to full page sections.

areas.name: Atoms
areas.description: The smallest building blocks such as buttons, text, images, and icons.

areas.name: Molecules
areas.description: Small groups of atoms combined into reusable pieces like cards, fields, menus, and footers.

areas.name: Organisms
areas.description: Larger composed sections such as decks, slides, forms, and timelines built from molecules and atoms.

areas.name: Templates
areas.description: Full page layouts, such as the talk template, that arrange organisms into a finished screen.

areas.name: Foundations Docs
areas.description: Storybook documentation pages that showcase color, type, radius, and measurement foundations.

areas.name: Runtime
areas.description: The client and server runtime that hydrates islands, renders on the server, and bridges to Preact/React.

areas.name: App Shell
areas.description: The root application entry and setup files that wire the design system together for rendering.

areas.name: Hooks
areas.description: Shared interactive behaviors like reveal animations and centered-state tracking used across components.

areas.name: MCP Server
areas.description: The MCP server that lets an AI agent consult the 540 design system while assembling a piece.

areas.name: MCP Tools
areas.description: The individual queries an agent can call, such as fetching a component, its docs, stories, patterns, rules, or the template and its stops.

areas.name: MCP Transports
areas.description: The ways the MCP server can be run and reached, over stdio, HTTP, or as a Firebase function.

areas.name: Build Scripts
areas.description: The scripts that build the component library, the MCP metadata, and the Firebase deployment bundle.

areas.name: Piece Checks
areas.description: Scripts that render and validate assembled pieces, checking islands and DOM output against the tag contract rules.
